name: std::basic_string_view<CharT,Traits>::remove_prefix
intro:
Moves the start of the view forward by n characters.

The behavior is undefined if n > size().

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
n

 -

 number of characters to remove from the start of the view

examples.output:
String: '   trim me'
View  : 'trim me'
There are 3 bees in this hive.

summary: Moves the start of the view forward by n characters.
